about: Mods tried in the game one by one (D-084): each as catalogue/checks.json's entries, with `proof.try` (kiln/proof.py,
KILN_PROOF_ONLY=try): what the player does and what must show. `result` says how the try went: works (then the mod
is in catalogue/verified.json and checks.json too), or doesn't, and why. Run on the PC: sh ~/kiln-runs/try.sh <branch> <ids>;

mods.name: Armor Glance
mods.feature: Each piece of armour worn, its icon and durability, in slots beside the hotbar.

steps: item replace entity @s armor.head with minecraft:diamond_helmet[damage=120]
item replace entity @s armor.chest with minecraft:iron_chestplate
item replace entity @s armor.feet with minecraft:leather_boots[damage=60]

result.evidence: In the game, with worn diamond helmet, iron chestplate and leather boots put on by command: their three icons beside the hotbar with 243, 240 and 5 left, as worn (the corner 0.0 between two shots before, changed after); 5 of 5 Java mods running, no failed call, java.log clean. Screenshots looked at. Its slot frames around the icons don't show: they are a texture (GuiGraphicsExtractor.blit, a name only in Kiln 0.3.0, which does nothing).
